title: Variational Atlas Autoencoders and Self-Supervised Chart Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.33577v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Complex, high-dimensional data lie on manifolds that a single global latent coordinate system cannot represent without distortion. We introduce Variational Atlas Autoencoders, a mixture-of-charts framework that learns an atlas of local latent representations, each responsible for one region of the data manifold. The central difficulty in learning an atlas is deciding which chart should be responsible for which data point without labels. We show that this decision need not be a heuristic. By treating the chart index as a latent variable, the evidence lower bound yields the training objective and casts chart assignment as posterior inference, valid for any routing distribution. Within this framework, we propose latent-evidence routing, which assigns a point to a chart in proportion to the evidence of its encoding under that chart's latent prior. translated_title: 变分图册自编码器与自监督图表选择
translated_abstract: 复杂的高维数据分布在流形上，而单一的全局潜在坐标系无法无失真地表示这些流形。我们提出了变分图册自编码器，这是一种混合图表框架，它学习由局部潜在表示构成的图册，其中每个局部表示负责数据流形的一个区域。学习图册的核心困难在于：如何在无标签的情况下决定哪个图表应该负责哪个数据点。我们证明这一决策不必依赖启发式方法。通过将图表索引视为潜在变量，证据下界直接给出了训练目标，并将图表分配转化为后验推断问题，且对任意路由分布均有效。在该框架内，我们提出了潜在证据路由，它按照数据点在该图表的潜在先验下编码所得的证据强度，成比例地将数据点分配给相应图表。这有一个简单的解释：数据点落在某图表潜在空间的中……
tldr: 本文提出变分图册自编码器，通过将图表索引作为潜在变量并利用潜在证据路由实现自监督的图表分配，以局部潜在表示组成的图册来无失真地刻画复杂高维数据的流形结构。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Variational Atlas Autoencoders, a mixture-of-charts framework that treats chart index as a latent variable and proposes latent-evidence routing for self-supervised chart assignment, enabling distortion-free representation of complex high-dimensional data manifolds via an atlas of local latent representations.
